title: 2100 Prairie's roof takes its carved dormers and stack
items: The Sherman house's roof now looks more like its c. 1890 photograph: the small dormer over the front door is a stone face under a projecting shelf with a slated hood leaning back over it, and the large dormer over the parlour has a stone coping up its gable, a little pinnacle at each shoulder and a finial on top.

The great chimney on the 21st Street side has a carved stone head with three tall round flues standing in a row, instead of a plain brick stack, and the library's tall front gable has a carved stone panel.
